parameters.query: SELECT name, data FROM public.key_value_store WHERE name IN ('DOMAIN_EXPIRATION_CONFIG', 'PERSONAL_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID')

nodes.name: Get Domain Config
nodes.notes: Always emit an item when the table has no matching rows, so config validation reports missing keys.

nodes.name: Parse Domain Config
nodes.notes: Parse the TEXT data column with JSON.parse. Validate the complete list, normalize and deduplicate domain names, and emit one item per domain. An empty domains array stops the run.

nodes.name: Loop Domains
nodes.notes: Batch size 1. Done is output 0; loop is output 1. Each domain finishes its lookup and optional notification before the next starts.

nodes.name: Fetch ICANN Data
nodes.notes: Use the existing internal Selenium/ICANN service. Non-2xx and transport errors are normalized by Analyze Domain.

nodes.name: Analyze Domain
nodes.notes: Parse the ICANN registry-expiration span, calculate floored days with a minimum of zero, and apply the existing 60/30/15 and <=10-day rules. Request and parse failures become per-domain results.

nodes.name: Telegram - Lookup Error
nodes.notes: Preserve the existing error-notification bot. Sending failures are recorded and do not stop later domains.

nodes.name: Telegram - Expiration Alert
nodes.notes: Preserve the existing expiration-alert bot. No persistent deduplication: critical domains alert on every daily or manual run.

nodes.name: Record Notification Result
nodes.notes: Restore the current domain result after Telegram replaces the item with its API response; record confirmed delivery or failure before advancing the loop.

nodes.name: Run Summary
nodes.notes: Execution output only; no daily success notification. partial_error means at least one lookup or Telegram send failed. Config/database failures still fail the execution.

parameters.content:
## Single configured domain-expiration workflow

Read `DOMAIN_EXPIRATION_CONFIG` from `public.key_value_store.data` as serialized JSON text:
`{"domains":["example.com"]}`

Also requires `PERSONAL_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID`.
Optional JSON field: `lookupUrl` overrides the existing internal ICANN endpoint.

Reselect the `automation-db` PostgreSQL credential and the two Telegram bot credentials after import.
Disable the three old per-domain workflows before activating this replacement.

See README.md and ../../database/domain-expiration/config.example.sql. Manual Test sends real notifications when a domain qualifies.
